name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.323.0 — Predictable stops become host policy: a new policy.stops block in the host config (repairRound, buildEscalate, reviewEscalate, redFindings, prototypeClose), written with safe defaults, answers the review repair round, build and review escalations and critical-tier red findings with a printed vetoable auto-pick shared by solo runs and lanes; deleting a prototype stays a question by default. The fan-out's PREFLIGHT standing sheet is retired (--ask <key> relays a stop for one run), and /spec:fix no longer asks before committing a dirty tree — /git:commit's own approvals are the stop. 7.322.0 — The worker version-control ban is now enforced, not just stated: a PreToolUse Bash hook refuses every writing verb while a worker-dispatching build step is open, reads pass; core Worker Ban section names the enforcer. 7.321.0 — The mocks provenance ledger is deleted end to end (grammar, gate, confirmation round, counts line, exclusion rows, roadmap parking-lot check and the mocks-ledger template); the scaffold tournament's race-or-skip question becomes an auto-picked skip with a veto; the roadmap brief drops its unread Risk, Design stage, Lane and Expected specs fields and the genesis brief its duplicate Journeys section; ops-ADR derive and coverage passes and the mocks legacy-status edge paragraphs are removed.
